summary: Hardware diagnostic research profile. Candidate features: jog,pad,fader,eq,audio,usb. Software: DJUCED,Serato DJ Lite.
identityNotes: Research seed; DJControl Inpulse 500: manufacturer-documented USB Audio/MIDI and audio routing. USB identifiers, class compliance, firmware/OS compatibility and physical performance remain unverified; no factory tolerances or control mappings are claimed.

documents.title: DJControl Inpulse 500 English user manual
documents.notes: Checked 2026-11-18. Sections 3.2, 4.3, 5.5 and 6 document audio channels and USB transport. No document revision or firmware baseline was identified.

documents.title: MIDI/HID map
documents.notes: Exact implementation mapping not verified; use learn mode and capture.

analog: MASTER stereo output: RCA L/R and 6.35 mm mono jack L/R; both connector pairs carry channels 1–2
Headphones stereo output: 3.5 mm and 6.35 mm jacks; channels 3–4
AUX stereo input: RCA L/R and 3.5 mm stereo jack

specs.label: Candidate hardware test groups
specs.notes: Model-dependent test planner; not exact control count or specification.

specs.label: USB audio input channels
specs.notes: Aux and Mic are mixed in hardware and available to software on input channels 1–2.

specs.label: USB audio output channels
specs.notes: Master uses channels 1–2; headphones use channels 3–4. Connector alternatives do not add USB channels.

specs.label: USB host transport
specs.notes: Manufacturer-documented transport; USB identifiers and exact control messages remain unverified.

tests.title: Jog movement, touch and direction
tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings.
steps: Check DJControl Inpulse 500 official manual, ports and operating mode.
Exercise all jog controls or signal routes using MIDI monitor, DJ software or external measurement as appropriate.
Repeat, save evidence and distinguish unobservable from failed hardware.
equipment: Compatible host or measurement interface as needed
